## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the user-visible change and link its issue. Use `Closes #number` only
when this PR completes the issue's acceptance criteria.

## Validation

List the exact checks run and their outcomes. For documentation-only changes,
check the commands, links, and factual claims. Explain any checks not run.

## Review checklist

- [ ] The scope is focused and generated files are identified.
- [ ] Behavior changes include regression tests and documentation.
- [ ] Changelog entries describe meaningful changes under Unreleased.
- [ ] Examples contain no credentials or private data.
- [ ] The diff contains no per-posting scores, skill gaps, or resume content.
- [ ] New model calls follow the shared budget and usage-accounting policy.
- [ ] Incomplete work has a TODO linked to a GitHub issue.
- [ ] Text, comments, and commit messages contain no em or en dashes.
